Package index

Start here

The terms used across the package, a run to try them on, and where to read more.

malariafwd malariafwd-package
malariafwd: concepts and terms
example_run()
A small run that ships with the package

Set up

malariafwd runs the external program SLiM, and reads the tree sequence with Python’s tskit. Check what the package finds before anything else.

check_setup()
Check what malariafwd needs: R, SLiM, the model, and Python with tskit
slim_available()
Is a SLiM binary available?
slim_model()
Path to the bundled SLiM model template
tskit_available()
Can the tree-sequence functions reach Python with tskit?

Configure and run

Build a parameter set, run one simulation, or run a grid of parameter sets and seeds in parallel. Time is in days throughout.

vivax_params() as.data.frame(<vivax_params>)
Build a validated parameter set for the vivax model
param_info()
What each parameter means, its unit and the values it may take
run_sim()
Run one simulation
run_grid()
Run a grid of parameter sets x seeds in parallel
load_grid()
Load the record of a grid

Set the oocyst and sporozoite draws

LAMBDA_OOCYSTS and LAMBDA_SPOROZOITES are rates before zero-truncation, not the mean counts a feeding study reports: convert between the two before setting them.

uptake_moments()
Realised mean and variance of a zero-truncated count distribution
uptake_calibrate()
Convert a target realised mean (and variance) into lambda and k

Read a run’s outputs

The files a run writes: the event log, the daily state of every host and mosquito, the parameters it was made from, and its tree sequence.

load_run()
Load a completed run as a vivax_run object
load_events()
Load the event log of a run
load_state()
Load the per-tick state table of a run
load_params()
The parameter set a run was made from
trees_path()
Path to a run's tree-sequence file
event_types()
The malariafwd event dictionary
malariafwd-outputs events.tsv state.tsv params.tsv plasmo.trees
The files a run writes, and their columns

Check a run

Summary numbers and a dashboard, to see whether a run went extinct, saturated or settled.

summarise_run()
A run's epidemiology over one window of days
plot_diagnostics()
One-glance run-health dashboard

Cases and their origin

Every blood-stage clone and recurrence, labelled by its true origin (relapse, local reinfection, import or recrudescence), beside the classes surveillance would give it, and incidence and force of infection by origin.

episodes()
Every blood-stage clone of a run, from onset to end
recurrences()
Each recurrence, against the earlier episodes of its host
classify_cases()
Classify each blood-stage clone onset ("case") by its true origin
classify_chain()
Classify each case by its transmission chain from an import (the WHO classes)
classify_travel()
Each case as a travel rule classes it: recent travel or not
force_of_infection()
Incidence and force of blood-stage infection, by origin
plot_force_of_infection()
Force of blood-stage infection: molFOB vs FOI

Hosts over time

Infection states across the population, complexity of infection, and one host’s history.

host_state_prevalence()
Host-state prevalence and the hypnozoite reservoir over time
plot_host_state_prevalence()
Host-state prevalence over time (stacked area)
coi_distribution()
Distribution of complexity of infection over the infected host-days
plot_host_trajectory()
Within-host trajectory for one host

Hypnozoites and relapse

The dormant liver-stage reservoir and the relapses it drives.

relapse_fraction()
Relapse fraction, by episodes and by acquisitions
dormancy_durations()
Hypnozoite dormancy durations, from a batch to each of its relapses
time_to_relapse()
Time from an infection to the first relapse of its hypnozoite batch
plot_relapse_km()
Kaplan-Meier curve of the time to first relapse, per hypnozoite batch

Transmission chains

Who infected whom, by a bite or through a relapse, and onward transmission by origin.

transmission_links()
Who infected whom: the ground-truth transmission links
rc_by_origin()
Case reproduction number (Rc) by true origin

Relatedness (IBD)

Identity by descent read exactly from the recorded genealogy, not inferred from markers: pairwise IBD, the segments behind it, and pairs of known relationship for testing an IBD method. Needs Python with tskit.

ibd_pairs()
Ground-truth IBD from a run's tree sequence
ibd_lookup() as.matrix(<vivax_ibd>) as.data.frame(<vivax_ibd>)
The IBD of pairs of genomes, from ibd_pairs()
ibd_segments()
Pairwise IBD segments along the genome
chrom_map()
Chromosome layout of a run's concatenated genome
plot_ibd_pair()
Plot the IBD "karyotype" of one or more pairs
ibd_truth_pairs()
Pairs of genomes with a known true relationship, and their IBD
plot_relatedness_ladder()
Plot the relatedness ladder
new_infection_diversity()
Genetic diversity of new infections, over the run or by window

Genotype data

Marker genotypes painted on the run’s genealogy, and their VCF.

simulate_genotypes() print(<vivax_genotypes>)
Simulate marker genotypes from a run's genealogy
write_vcf()
Write simulated genotypes as a VCF file

Genealogy summaries

The recorded genealogy (the ancestral recombination graph, ARG) is a forest of unconnected founder lineages: read ?arg_summary first, and use arg_tmrca() for relatedness.

arg_summary()
Structure of the recorded ancestral recombination graph (ARG)
arg_tmrca()
Pairwise time to the most recent common ancestor, the relatedness measure of the ancestral recombination graph
